annotations.title: Fact sheet for one Los Angeles hotel

description: The fact sheet Journeyed holds for one Los Angeles area hotel: every verified fact (parking and its price, fees, pet rules, check-in and checkout times, pool, breakfast, accessibility and more) with its source URL and checked date, the Journeyed Score and what backs it, hotel class and awards, former names, straight-line, walking and driving distances to nearby landmarks, and the list of facts Journeyed does not know. Use it for any question about a named hotel. A fact listed under unknown is not on record at Journeyed, which is different from the hotel not offering it. It holds no reviews, room prices or availability.

hotel.description: Hotel name (current or former), or its journeyed.org page URL. Examples: "The Anthem", "Santa Monica Proper Hotel".

name: get_hotel

candidates.description: When found is false: the closest hotel names. Call again with one of them.

items.description: One sourced fact. sourceUrl (a web page) or dataset (an open dataset id) says where it came from; checkedOn is the date it was last checked (YYYY-MM-DD).

recognition.description: Hotel class and recognized awards (AAA, Forbes Travel Guide, MICHELIN Keys), each with its source.

items.description: One sourced fact. sourceUrl (a web page) or dataset (an open dataset id) says where it came from; checkedOn is the date it was last checked (YYYY-MM-DD).

score.description: The Journeyed Score (0 to 100) measures how much about the hotel is verified, not how good it is. backedBy says what it rests on.

unknown.description: Fact keys Journeyed has no verified value for at this hotel. Unknown, not "no".
